describes: `409` · `ITEM_UNAVAILABLE`. `replaceCart` is all or nothing. Two of the lines from the old order can't be added today: the code is the first failure's, and `details.lines` names every failing line by its position in the request. The cart is unchanged; the app can offer to put back the rest by calling again without lines 1 and 2.

error.message: Some items can't be put back in your cart.
